goal: Independently reconstruct summary.txt from build-notes.md and records.csv alone, producing a deterministic produce_summary(csv_text) and an unbiased enumeration of what the notes leave undetermined.

nodes.instructions: Read build-notes.md and records.csv. These are your only inputs. Do not assume any file named summary.txt exists or has any particular contents; you have no access to the target output.
nodes.why_necessary: The reproduction must be grounded strictly in the notes and the source data; the inputs must be acquired before any construction step.

nodes.instructions: Author produce_summary.py exposing produce_summary(csv_text: str) -> str, implementing ONLY the transformation described in build-notes.md, making no choice the notes do not state (do not invent an ordering, a letter case, a decimal format, or a trailing newline the notes do not require; where the notes are silent, pick the most literal reading of the notes and record that a choice was forced). Compute produce_summary applied to the exact text of records.csv. Then, derived purely from the notes, enumerate every aspect of the output (line ordering, region-name case, numeric/decimal formatting, trailing newline, line terminator, separators) that the notes leave as a free choice affecting the output bytes. Write reproduction.json per the deliverable shape.
nodes.why_necessary: Addresses the two assigned distinctions Q1 (independent byte-level reproduction) and Q2 (independent underdetermination enumeration) with a mechanically reproducible artifact.

nodes.instructions: Re-read produce_summary.py and reproduction.json. Confirm produce_summary.py is self-contained, deterministic, defines produce_summary(csv_text: str) -> str, references no file other than its csv_text argument, and that reproduced_output equals produce_summary applied to records.csv. Confirm every listed underdetermined aspect is justified from the notes alone, not from any assumed target. Record the structural check outcome. This check is non-authoritative.
nodes.why_necessary: The contract requires the verify primitive in any Write-holding topology; a structural self-check before return is the minimal fulfilment.

nodes.instructions: Finalize reproduction.json as the deliverable and finalize the child ledger, ending with a complete event. Do not attempt any comparison against a target you do not possess.
nodes.why_necessary: The child's evidence must re-enter the governed boundary as a returned, named deliverable.

ledger_contract.schema: normalized formal event schema: one JSON object per line with event_id, label, actor, timestamp, artifact_refs, metadata; node executions carry metadata.completes_node
